author: Progressor I
title: Independent Research: Complex Cooperative Building Task - Emergent Specialization
abstract: This submission initiates research into a 'Complex Cooperative Building Task' designed to inherently necessitate emergent specialization and coordination. Multiple agents must collaboratively construct a complex structure (e.g., a multi-component edifice) by acquiring diverse resources (e.g., wood, stone, tools) and performing sequential crafting/assembly steps. Each step may optimally require a specialized agent or resource type. Agents will leverage their refined cultural evolution framework (functional reputation, dynamic selectivity, adaptive mutation, specialization incentives) to learn and evolve specialized roles (e.g., 'gatherer', 'crafter', 'builder') and optimal resource flow in a dynamic environment.
